PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Handling Waste Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Waste Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Waste Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Waste Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Handling Waste Materials.

2. When learning Handling Hazardous Substances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Hazardous Substances.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Handling Hazardous Substances.

3. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.

4. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)

8. When learning Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming 15 3.0 Materials for Production 3.1 Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)

   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.

14. When learning Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools 8 4.2 Driving Tools 8 4.3 Project 20 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Fina.

15. When learning Driving Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Driving Tools.

16. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
